data_fields.name: lock_range_units
data_fields.donor_constant: 512 units (RING_DIST), doubled for bullet, times player scale

data_fields.name: lock_elevation_half_deg_bullet
data_fields.donor_constant: same span as horizontal cone (30 degrees)

best_idea: A lock-on search that gates by cheap range and cone tests first, picks the nearest valid target, and checks line of sight last, with reach and cone set per attack mode as data.
decision_why: Cone, nearest-wins and sight-last order with reach and cone as ability data fits row 4 for many-on-one target choice; the donor tie rule, mixed reference heights and full-list scan are fixed, and stickiness is added, while the flag-word validity and flipped-gravity branches are rejected.
acceptance: A server test with two enemies at equal distance locks the lower id every time; a target outside the cone or behind a wall is never locked; a lock stays on a target that drifts slightly out of the narrow cone; a homing lock cannot pick a target more than the step height above the seeker; the server rejects a lock id that fails its range, cone or sight test.
